description: Shared Renovate rules: Actions pinned to commits, pre-commit pins moved, the kilotronic check tools in one update, weekly, Python held. Merges nothing by itself; extend :automerge as well where required CI gates merges.

copier.description: Off: .copier-answers.yml names a private template by copier's gh: shorthand and pins a commit id, not a tag, so the copier manager only logs lookup failures. Turn it on here once the answers point at tagged public templates.

packageRules.description: Python (uv, pip) minor and patch updates in one PR.
npm minor and patch updates in one PR.
GitHub Actions updates in one PR.

The kilotronic check tools move together: each is pinned in more than one place (an Action or reusable workflow in CI, a pre-commit rev), and a PR per manager would move one pin and leave the other behind. Matches the separate tool repos and kilotronic/checks, which merges them. Must stay the last grouping rule: later packageRules win, so a grouping rule below would split the pins again.
Dotted releases only for the check tools, in every manager. Each also keeps a moving major tag (v1); a bare major offered to one manager and not the other is the skew the group exists to prevent.
Python itself moves by hand, only when a bump is needed; patches still flow. Every home (.python-version, Docker base images, setup-python) has the dep name python, so this one rule holds them all.
